$comment: Stable validation codes shared by the Android app, the website and packer. Codes are never renamed or reused; new codes may be added. See docs/pack-format.md#error-codes.

codes.description: The file is not a readable zip archive (bad signature, truncated, corrupt central directory or CRC mismatch).
The zip uses a feature packs may not use: encryption, a compression method other than stored or deflate, or multiple disks.
An entry or the whole archive expands beyond the allowed decompression ratio (zip bomb guard).
Two entries have the same path, compared case-insensitively.
An entry path is absolute, contains '.' or '..' segments, backslashes, a drive letter or control characters (zip slip guard).
An entry is a symbolic link, hard link, device or other non-regular file.
A path segment uses characters outside [A-Za-z0-9._-], starts with '-', or the path is longer than 255 characters or deeper than 8 levels.
A file has an executable or script extension, or a media file starts with an executable signature (ELF, PE, Mach-O, DEX).
A file extension is not on the allowlist of audio, image, manifest and text types.
A single file exceeds the size limit for its type.
A pack holds more than 5,000 files or an archive more than 20,000 entries.
The unpacked size exceeds 1 GiB for a pack or 2 GiB for a bundle.
Neither pack.json nor bundle.json is at the root.
Both pack.json and bundle.json are at the root.
An operating system artifact (__MACOSX/, .DS_Store, Thumbs.db, desktop.ini or another dot file) was skipped.
The unpacked size is over 256 MiB; the app asks before installing.
A manifest, index or backup is not valid UTF-8 JSON (a byte order mark is not allowed), or a standalone index or backup is over its size cap.
formatVersion is an integer newer than this reader supports (a missing or malformed formatVersion is a SCHEMA_VIOLATION).
A manifest or index does not match its JSON Schema.
Two characters in a pack, two packs in a bundle, or two entries in a repository index share an ID.
A path referenced by a manifest does not exist.
A referenced file has the wrong kind for its role (for example an image used as a clip, or a PNG as an animated sprite).
A folder listed in bundle.json has no pack.json.
Bundle pack folders overlap, contain a nested bundle.json, or are the bundle root.
A custom haptic breaks a timeline rule: events out of order, overlapping envelopes, an envelope not ending at zero intensity, or longer than 5 s.
A ringtone or clip 'when' condition is empty or contradictory: a time range whose start equals its end, or a date that is not a calendar day (02-30, 04-31).
Ringtone loop points are reversed, closer than 1 s, or (media stage) beyond the end of the audio.
The license is not an SPDX license expression; it is shown as free text.
A media file is not referenced by any manifest and will not be installed.
An audio or image file does not match its extension's signature or its headers cannot be parsed.
A notification clip is shorter than 0.2 s or longer than 30 s (50 ms tolerance).
A ringtone is shorter than 5 s or longer than 6 min (50 ms tolerance).
A bitmap image is wider or taller than 512 px.
An SVG contains scripts, event handlers, foreignObject, a DOCTYPE or entities, or references anything outside the file.
A downloaded file's size differs from the repository index.
A downloaded file's SHA-256 differs from the repository index or backup.
An encrypted backup could not be decrypted (wrong passphrase or tampered file).
The pack being imported has a lower version than the installed one; the user must confirm.
The same pack ID and version is already installed; importing again replaces it after confirmation.
